A crash after qualification Begin but before Deliver can therefore recover a denial that was never invoked.

Native store ReadBoundedAsync constructs FileStream synchronously before inspecting type/size; opening a FIFO can hang before its cancellation-aware read. Existing Resolve checks reject symlinks but not FIFO/nonregular types. The bounded descriptor primitive is available and unused on this path.

ArchiveFileLease explicitly permits magic0x1021994(tmpfs) in both lock and filesystem identity paths. Native capacity uses that identity for its enrolled durable physical pool.
